description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You begin a Passing.

That Passing adds nothing to your Passage. The cost is not waived — it is held. The next Passing you perform, whenever that is, costs its own thresholds plus the ones you deferred. You cannot use this feat again while a deferred cost is outstanding, and Steady Passage can reduce the combined cost by one threshold, not by one each.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ashcantor's entire signature resource system (Passage, a Passing, Walking Through, Embers, Ash-Light) has zero rule-element representation anywhere in this corpus -- the class card itself (classes.ashcantor.json) ships system.rules: [], and no abilities/ or class-features/ card exists to hold a Passage/Ember mechanic either. Checked pf2e's own generic SpecialResource rule element (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts:24-247) as a possible fit: every real user (Alchemist's Versatile Vials, Gunslinger's Munitions Machinist, Fumbus's iconic feats) is a daily-refilling consumable counter, never a one-way permanent-increase track like Passage -- no real class resource matches Passage's shape, so there is no base mechanic here to extend or modify. Specifically, this defers a Passage cost to a later Passing -- there is no field to write a "held" cost into, and no selector for "the next time this actor performs a Passing."
